title: Veterans shouldn't sleep rough this Christmas, Burnham says
description: Downing Street says the prime minister will personally write to councils on Armistice Day to urge them to draw up plans.

title: Royal Family join veterans and families at Festival of Remembrance
description: The senior royals attended the annual event at London's Royal Albert Hall on the eve of Remembrance Sunday.

title: Two seriously hurt in 30-vehicle crash on the M20 in Kent
description: The crash happened in fog on Saturday evening on the London-bound carriageway near Maidstone, Kent.

title: Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government
description: Neither PM Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor that of his rival secured a majority in last week's election.

title: Germans wrestle with what to do with Hitler's destroyed Eagle's Nest retreat
description: While some believe the site should be partially or completely rebuilt, others want it abandoned and all memory of its Nazi past forgotten.

title: My parents chose to die together and I was left to grieve alone
description: Els and Jan sought medical intervention to end their lives after 50 happy years of marriage, leaving behind their only child.

title: Andy Burnham wants to get closer to the EU - but he shouldn't expect a smooth ride
description: Laura Kuenssberg talks to government insiders about the prime minister opening the conversation about the UK rejoining the EU.

title: Labubu hype seemed unstoppable, now the fluffy monster mania is fading
description: Parent company Pop Mart's revenue has fallen as appetite for the quirky collectible monsters wanes.

title: Can the Zelda remake capture the magic of the original?
description: Nintendo has released its remake of what is considered one of the best games ever made - the BBC's Tom Gerken gives his verdict.
